consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1984-07-04 show at Five Seasons Center was a high-energy performance with standout moments, particularly in the second set. Many reviewers praised the overall vibe and the quality of the remastering, which enhanced the listening experience despite some noted vocal issues.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 55 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the show and highlighted its energy, several reviews pointed out vocal issues and a sense of the band being tired, leading to a more tempered overall sentiment.
